AgentSelectionConfig.description:
Set in `config.toml` under `[agent]`: Priority (highest to lowest): ACP session-level `_meta.agentProfile`
CLI `--agent-profile` flag `[agent]` config.toml section (this config) `GROK_AGENT` env var
Default `grok-build` agent

definition.description:
Path to an agent definition file (.md with YAML frontmatter).
Supports environment variable expansion (e.g., `$HOME/.grok/agents/my-agent.md`).

name.description:
Name of a built-in or discovered agent definition.
Looked up via `xai_grok_agent::discovery::by_name_in_cwd()`.
Examples: "grok-build", "browser-use", or a custom agent name.

system_prompt_label.description: Global system-prompt identity label. Per-model override wins.

AnnouncementCta.description:
Optional call-to-action on an announcement (clients render it as a clickable link/button).
The server only emits it with both fields non-empty and the url https; parsing here stays tolerant like the parent struct.
`caption` is optional dim helper text after the button; absent means none.

AskUserQuestionToolConfig.description:
User configurable settings for the ask_user_question tool (`[toolset.ask_user_question]`). Consumed by `crate::util::config::resolve_ask_user_question_params_from_disk`, which reads the raw config layers directly.
That keeps the documented precedence (requirements > env > user > managed > remote). This struct exists so the keys are recognized in `config.toml` and round-trip through `AgentConfig`.

timeout_enabled.description:
Whether the questionnaire timeout is enabled (default: `true`).
`false` waits forever for answers.

timeout_secs.description: Wait budget in seconds when the timer is enabled (positive integer; default: 1800 / 30 minutes).

AutoModeConfig.description:
`[auto_mode]` section: server-side configuration for Auto permission mode. ONE struct serves both the local `[auto_mode]` TOML table and the remote settings `auto_mode` JSON object, so the two stay 1:1.
The remote object is coerced via `serde_json::from_value`. All fields are plain scalars/enums, so they deserialize cleanly from both formats (no custom tolerant deser needed). Unset fields stay `None` here.
The wire fn applies the built-in defaults once auto mode is enabled (current model, `low` effort if the model supports it, `just_command` prompt). Precedence: local config > remote > those built-in defaults.

classifier_model.description:
Routing slug for a dedicated classifier model.
`None` inherits the session model.
Resolved via `resolve_aux_model_sampling_config`.

classify_timeout_ms.description: Classifier side-query duration in milliseconds; resolved with bounded defaults.

enabled.description:
The Auto-mode gate.
Lowest-precedence layer of the gate chain (env and local `[auto_mode] enabled` config win over this remote value).

prompt_type.description:
How much context the classifier prompt includes.
`None` means the wire fn's built-in default (`just_command`).

reasoning_effort.description:
Classifier reasoning effort. Applies on BOTH the routed-model path and the inherited session-model path.
`None` means the wire fn's built-in default (`low` if the effective model supports reasoning effort, else unset).

BashToolConfig.description: User configurable settings for the built-in bash tool (`[toolset.bash]`).

allow_background_operator.description:
Whether to allow a background `&` operator in foreground commands (default: `true`).
Resolution: config.toml (this) > remote settings > `true`.

auto_background_on_timeout.description: Whether to auto-background a command when it times out (default: `true`).

foreground_block_budget_ms.description:
How long a command may block the foreground before auto-backgrounding, in milliseconds, when `auto_background_on_timeout` is on.
`None` uses the server default of 15s.
`Some(0)` disables the short budget, so auto-backgrounding happens only at the model/default timeout.

max_timeout_secs.description:
Foreground ceiling for model-provided command timeouts (seconds).
When `None`, `to_bash_params_json` emits the production default ([`PRODUCTION_MAX_TIMEOUT_SECS`], 10h).

ClassifierPromptType.description:
How much context [`build_classifier_messages`] includes (decreasing order).
Also the type of the `[auto_mode] prompt_type` config field; the shell reads it straight off the resolved config.
Serde wire values are the snake_case variant names.
Operator-facing meaning of each variant:
- `full`: system, AGENTS.md, transcript, proposed action, and the JSON instruction.
- `no_user_tool_prefix`: drops the conversation transcript (the `User:` / tool-call turns); keeps AGENTS.md.
- `bare_instructions`: system, proposed action, and the JSON instruction (no AGENTS.md, no transcript).
- `just_command`: system and the command to judge only (json_schema still enforces the output shape).

minimum_version.description:
Env `GROK_MINIMUM_VERSION`.
See [`crate::util::config::VersionPolicy`] for the version-policy knobs.
(Unrelated to `version_overrides[].maximum_version`, which gates config patches.)

session_picker_grouped.description: Group sessions by repo in the picker and CLI listings.

CodebaseIndexingSetting.description:
Codebase indexing setting for `[features] codebase_indexing`.
Patterns are matched against the git root when available, otherwise the cwd, which allows explicitly indexing non-git directories.

CompactionAtTokens.description:
Per-model config for the `x-compaction-at` request header (a token count). The remote-config value is polymorphic:
`true` enables the header with the value `context_window * auto_compact_threshold_percent / 100`. `false` (or absent)
disables it; an integer `N` sends the constant `N`.

CompactionsRemaining.description:
Per-model config for the `x-compactions-remaining` request header. `true` sends the dynamic value (1 on the
uncompacted prefix, 0 once the session compacts). `false`/absent disables the header; an integer `N` sends the
constant `N`.

ConfigModelOverride.description:
A `[model.foo]` entry from config.toml, parsed directly from raw TOML (bypassing deep merge).
Scalar fields are `Option` so absent means "inherit from defaults/prefetched".
The collection fields (`extra_headers`, `reasoning_efforts`) merge only when non-empty and so cannot express "override to empty."

auth_provider.description:
Name of a `[auth_provider.<name>]` credential helper that mints this model's bearer token.
Static `api_key` / `env_key` win when both are set.

auto_compact_threshold_percent.description:
Per-model auto-compact threshold override (0-100) from `[model.<id>]`.
Read directly by `resolve_auto_compact_threshold_percent`.
Intentionally NOT merged into `ModelInfo.auto_compact_threshold_percent` so the resolver can keep user-per-model distinct from GB-per-model.

cache_ttl.description:
Messages-wire stable-head cache retention tier ("5m" or "1h").
Absent = inherit (donor/prefetched, else `[models]` global, else
the wire default 5m).

compactions_remaining.description: Aliases must be registered in `config_model_override_parse::ALIASES`; serde rejects a table that contains both spellings otherwise.

disable_parallel_tool_use.description: Disable parallel tool use (F5, apex-ayl.114). Absent = inherit.

env_key.description: Env var name(s) for the provider key: string or array in config.toml.

mcp_servers.description:
Remote MCP server declarations (F1, apex-ayl.115, BETA shape),
array-of-tables row value. Absent = inherit.

mcp_toolset_server.description:
Names an `mcp_servers` entry; pairs with the "mcp_toolset" member
(F1, apex-ayl.115). Absent = inherit.

mtls_cert_dir.description:
Directory containing this model's mTLS client certificate and private key.
Requires one HTTPS `base_url`; an alternate `api_base_url` is rejected.

multi_agent_v2.description: Per-model native (v2) multi-agent gate (MA-3, spec Q1.2); `None` = dark.

server_tools.description:
Server-tool member selection (F1, apex-ayl.115), comma-separated
family names or dated slugs. Absent = inherit.

stop_sequences.description: Custom stop strings (docs GA L1246), comma-separated. Absent = inherit.

strict_responses_input.description:
True when the target backend enforces the strict OpenAI/Azure
Responses input schema (replayed reasoning items with a non-empty
`content` array 400 with `array_above_max_length` — REPLAY-1).
Absent = false (lenient, byte-identical replay).

system_prompt_label.description: Per-model system-prompt identity; not merged into `ModelInfo` (tiered resolve).

thinking_replay.description:
Older-assistant thinking replay policy (apex-ayl.108.1).
Absent = inherit.

tools_cache_breakpoint.description:
Per-tool cache breakpoint (F5, apex-ayl.114), `off` | `last`.
Absent = inherit.

top_k.description: Top-k sampling (docs GA L3060). Absent = inherit.

ContextualHints.description:
User-config opt-outs for the per-tip contextual hints, serialized as `[ui.contextual_hints]`.
Per-field `None` means "inherit remote/default"; `Some(bool)` is a user-explicit choice (needed so the resolver can let it beat the remote tier).

export_copy.description: Export/copy tip after three nearby drag-copies.

send_now.description: Send-now tip after queuing a mid-turn follow-up.

small_screen.description: Small-screen tip (`/compact-mode` hint on smallish terminals).

ssh_wrap.description: SSH wrap session-load tip (recommend `grok wrap ssh` when the session runs over SSH without an OSC 52 sink).

undo.description: Undo tip (Ctrl+Z after a substantial draft wipe).

word_select.description: Word-select tip after double-clicking scrollback while Text selection is still fold/nav (`flash` / `hold`).

ConversationGroupId.description: Stable identifier shared by every model request in one root conversation tree.

DisplayRefreshSettings.description:
Display-refresh probe and auto-cadence settings: one struct for local `[ui.display_refresh]`, remote `display_refresh`, and `UiConfig`.
Each field deserializes tolerantly (wrong types become `None`); unknown keys land in [`Self::extra`] so a settings save cannot drop future knobs.
`resolve_display_refresh` resolves it.
Client defaults: probe on, auto on, floor 8 ms, ceiling 16 ms, Hz band 55 to 240.

auto_cadence_enabled.description: Derive paint/scroll cadence from a successful in-band probe (default off).

max_hz.description: Maximum accepted probe Hz for auto-cadence (default 165).

min_hz.description: Minimum accepted probe Hz for auto-cadence (default 55).

probe_enabled.description: Probe the primary display's Hz once per process. `Some(false)` is a kill-switch.

DoomLoopRecoveryPolicy.description:
The resolver returns `None` when the check is disabled: absence IS the off state, so there is no separate enabled flag
to keep in sync. When present on `SamplerConfig`, the sampler both sends the opt-in request header and parses the
reported triggers. The tunables are consumed by the recovery decision logic.

max_retries.description: Resample budget per turn before accepting the response as-is.

max_threshold.description:
Act only on `tail_repetition:{t}@thinking` triggers with `t` at or below this value.
Lower thresholds indicate tighter, more confident loops.

window_tokens.description: Detector window sent as the value of [`DOOM_LOOP_CHECK_HEADER`].

DoomLoopRecoverySettings.description:
Doom-loop recovery settings: one struct serves both the local `[doom_loop_recovery]` TOML table and the remote `doom_loop_recovery` JSON object.
Every field is `Option` with a per-field default, so a partial object parses and unknown future keys are ignored.
Unset fields fall through per-field in `resolve_doom_loop_recovery`: env, then TOML, then remote, then default.
The namespace is distinct from the removed legacy `doom_loop_*` keys.

enabled.description:
Send the `x-grok-doom-loop-check` header, parse the reported triggers, and resample confident loops.
`Some(false)` is a kill-switch; absent uses the client default (on).

max_retries.description: Resample budget per turn (clamped to 0..=5); absent uses the client default (2).

max_threshold.description:
Highest `tail_repetition` threshold considered confident (clamped to 2..=64); absent uses the client default (64).
The server emits every fired threshold, and the client filters the returned trigger labels with this.
It is never sent as a request parameter.

window_tokens.description: Detector window sent as the value of `x-grok-doom-loop-check` (honored in 512..=4096, otherwise 4096; absent uses the client default, 1024).

alpha_test_key.description: Optional extra access-header value (applied only with the optional non-production feature, and only for matching first-party hosts).

cli_chat_proxy_base_url.description:
cli chat proxy base URL.
`None` means unset (resolvers apply the default); `Some` means explicitly configured.
Tracking explicitness (vs comparing to the default value) lets an org pin the proxy to the default on purpose.

default_agent_type.description: Harness agent type for hydrated models left at the built-in default.

default_api_backend.description:
Provider-level model routing defaults (P1 provider-default seam).
Applied to prefetched (remote-hydrated) models and `ModelEntry::fallback` entries
strictly for fields still at their built-in defaults, so priority is:
`[model.<id>]` config > donor (baked keys) > these defaults > built-in defaults.
TOML-only (no env-var overrides): these bind to the ACTIVE endpoint's provider,
unlike the infrastructure URLs above.
Backend wire for hydrated models: "chat_completions" | "responses" | "messages".

default_context_window.description: Context window (tokens) for hydrated models left at the built-in default.

default_env_key.description:
Env var name(s) for the provider key: string or array in config.toml.
The auth fix for hydrated models: without it, custom-endpoint models fall
through to the ambient `XAI_API_KEY` (the 403 class).

default_extra_headers.description: Extra headers for hydrated models whose own headers are empty (no merge).

default_model_family.description: Provider family for hydrated models with no explicit family.

deployment_key.description:
Env: `GROK_DEPLOYMENT_KEY`. Management API key for enterprise deployments.
Sent on telemetry and service requests for deployment-level attribution.

grok_internal_otlp_headers.description:
Env: `GROK_INTERNAL_OTLP_HEADERS`.
`k=v,k2=v2` extra headers for the internal export (debug).
Wins over the legacy `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS`.

grok_internal_otlp_traces_endpoint.description:
Env: `GROK_INTERNAL_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT`. Full INTERNAL traces endpoint, used verbatim.
Dev/debug repoint of the internal span firehose (replaces the legacy `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT` behavior).
Used by local-ic-testing / internal dev flows. Wins over the legacy `OTEL_*` vars.

managed_config_url.description:
Env: `GROK_MANAGED_CONFIG_URL`. Override the managed config endpoint.
Defaults to `{proxy_url()}/deployment/config`.

models_base_url.description:
Env: `GROK_MODELS_BASE_URL`. Enables custom endpoint mode.
List URL defaults to `{models_base_url}/models`.

models_list_url.description: Env: `GROK_MODELS_LIST_URL`. Overrides the default `{base}/models` list URL.

otel_exporter_otlp_endpoint.description:
Env: `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`. OTLP collector base; `/v1/traces` is appended.
Legacy repoint of the INTERNAL trace pipeline, deprecated in favor of `GROK_INTERNAL_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT`.
Ignored by the internal pipeline when `GROK_EXTERNAL_OTEL` is set (the standard `OTEL_*` vars then route the external stream only).

otel_exporter_otlp_headers.description:
Env: `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS`. `k=v,k2=v2`; merged onto export headers.
Same legacy/deprecation semantics as `otel_exporter_otlp_endpoint`.

otel_exporter_otlp_traces_endpoint.description:
Env: `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT`.
Full traces endpoint, used verbatim; overrides `otel_exporter_otlp_endpoint`.
Same legacy/deprecation semantics as `otel_exporter_otlp_endpoint`.

otel_traces_export_interval.description:
Env: `OTEL_BSP_SCHEDULE_DELAY` (OTel) or `OTEL_TRACES_EXPORT_INTERVAL` (Claude alias).
Batch flush interval (ms).

trace_upload_bucket.description: Env: `GROK_TRACE_UPLOAD_BUCKET`. Direct bucket (`gs://` or `s3://`), bypasses proxy.

trace_upload_credentials_file.description: Env: `GROK_TRACE_UPLOAD_CREDENTIALS_FILE`. Path to GCS SA key or AWS credentials file.

xai_api_base_url.description: Base URL for the public xAI API.

EnvKeys.description:
One or more environment variable names that may hold a model API key.
Serde `untagged`: accepts a string or an array in TOML/JSON.
At resolve time the **first set, non-blank** value wins (e.g. SSH `AcceptEnv LC_*` forwarding of the Bottlerocket token).

codebase_indexing.description:
Codebase graph indexing for go-to-definition/references.
Accepts: true | false | ["glob", "!negative-glob", ...]
Default: true (index any git repo). Patterns can explicitly match non-git directories.

compaction_detail.description:
`none` | `minimal` | `balanced` | `verbose` (default).
`None` defers to env (`GROK_COMPACTION_DETAIL`).
The `segments` verbatim detail level.

compaction_mode.description:
`summary` | `transcript` | `segments` (default).
`None` defers to CLI / env (`GROK_COMPACTION_MODE`).
Parsed via `CompactionMode::parse`.

image_gen_model_override.description:
`image_gen` Imagine model override.
`None`/empty defers to remote settings (`image_gen_model_override`) / env / default (`grok-imagine-image-quality`).

managed_config.description:
Managed config fetching (managed_config.toml and requirements.toml).
`None` defers to env / default (true).

mcp_auto_restart.description:
Bounded stdio auto-restart task. When `true`, the session-actor `StatusDispatcher` reacts to `TransportClosed` / `HandshakeFailed` events on stdio MCP servers.
It schedules up to 3 respawn attempts with `[1s, 4s, 16s]` backoff. HTTP / HttpAuth servers are NOT auto-restarted (their existing `reset_transport` path covers the recovery).
Not read through this struct: the live resolver re-reads the `[features]` key out-of-band from raw TOML in `util::config::resolve::mcp`. Declared so `serde_ignored` does not report it as an unrecognized key.

mcp_liveness_watchers.description:
Per-`Ready`-client transport-liveness pollers and the session-actor `StatusDispatcher`. When `true` (default), each successfully-handshaken MCP client gets a poller.
The poller detects rmcp service-loop termination and pushes `x.ai/mcp/server_status` updates to the client.
When `false`, neither watchers nor the dispatcher are spawned, useful as an emergency kill switch for the rollout. `None` defers to env / default (true). Not read through this struct: the live resolver re-reads the `[features]` key out-of-band from raw TOML in `util::config::resolve::mcp`. Declared so `serde_ignored` does not report it as an unrecognized key.

mcp_push_server_status.description:
Pager-side subscription to the `x.ai/mcp/server_status` push. Not read through this struct. The pager-side gate (`acp_handler::push_server_status_enabled`) uses an **env-only** OnceLock cache.
The `[features]` key itself is honoured out-of-band, re-read from raw TOML in `util::config::resolve::mcp`. This field is declared so `serde_ignored` does not report the key as unrecognized.
Practical consequence: setting `[features] mcp_push_server_status = false` in `~/.grok/config.toml` will NOT disable the pager's subscription on a freshly-launched process. To disable the pager subscription, set `GROK_MCP_PUSH_SERVER_STATUS=0` in the env before launch.

mcp_recursive_config_watch.description:
Whether the leader's `ConfigFileWatcher` adds the two narrow non-recursive watches for `<cwd>/` and `<cwd>/.grok/`. The only way to pick up a project-config edit is then the user-triggered refresh button.
The watches are **always non-recursive**; the name follows the convention for the rollout-gate flag. The name is a documented misnomer: it gates the existence of the **cwd** watches, NOT their recursion mode.
Not read through this struct: the live resolver re-reads the `[features]` key out-of-band from raw TOML in `util::config::resolve::mcp`. Declared so `serde_ignored` does not report it as an unrecognized key.

non_git_warning.description:
Show a blocking warning when Grok starts outside a Git repository. Default: false. Used as the local fallback when the `non_git_warning` remote settings flag in `grok_build_settings` is absent.
When the remote flag is present it takes precedence: `Some(false)` from remote settings overrides `true` here.

support_permission.description: when set, the agent may ask permission for tool executions

turn_transient_retry.description:
Transient turn-retry kill switch (`None` means on).
The resolver reads raw TOML; declared only so `serde_ignored` allows the key.

video_gen.description: Video tools / `/imagine-video`. `None` defers to env / remote / default (`true`).

FeedbackUserConfig.description:
Self-reported feedback author identity (never used for authorization).
Merged only from trusted config tiers, so a cloned repo can't inject the `command` escape hatch.

command.description:
Optional `sh -c` script printing `{"name","email"}` JSON; its fields win over the lists above, with per-field fallback.
Trusted config tiers only.

email.description:
Sources tried in order for the email.
`git_email` yields the global git email; any other entry is a literal (`$VAR` expanded at load) needing `@`.

email_domain.description: Fallback domain for `<name>@<domain>` when no `email` source resolves.

name.description:
Sources tried in order for the name.
`os_user` yields the OS user name; any other entry is a literal (`$VAR` expanded at load).

anyOf.description: Allowed teams; an empty list fails closed.

ForceLoginTeam.description: Team login restriction. TOML string or array; an empty array fails closed.

GoalConfig.description:
`[goal]` section: the canonical home for `/goal` configuration.
Field names mirror the remote `goal_*` keys with the prefix dropped, so config and remote stay 1:1.
Per-key precedence is env > this config > remote > default.

GoalRoleModel.description:
A model and the harness whose system prompt and toolset flavor that model must run against.
The pair is the atomic configurable unit because a model is only guaranteed to work with a compatible harness (cursor vs grok-build).

agent_type.description:
Harness `agent_type` (e.g. "cursor", "grok-build-plan") whose `AgentDefinition` decides the role subagent's harness flavor.
The flavor (system prompt and cursor-vs-grok-build toolset) applies regardless of the session or parent agent.
It is resolved by name (project/plugin/builtin lookup, then re-flavored by the subagent toolset resolver).
The main session's env/ACP/strict-harness precedence chain plays no part.
It is not a subagent type: the role always spawns `general-purpose`, so the harness only re-flavors that toolset.
An `agent_type` that doesn't resolve, or whose role toolset can't satisfy the role, fails open to the session model and harness before commit.
One that resolves to a strict harness whose flavor the subagent system can't represent (e.g. `codex`) fails open the same way.

model.description: Model id, e.g. "grok-4". It resolves against available models at spawn time; unknown or unauthorized fails open to the current model.

auth_provider_command.description: External auth provider command; stdout carries the token, stderr the user-facing output, and exit 0 means success.

auth_token_ttl.description:
Token TTL in seconds for external auth providers that output bare tokens without `expires_in`.
Synthesizes `expires_at` so proactive refresh works. Env: `GROK_AUTH_TOKEN_TTL`.

disable_api_key_auth.description:
Admin kill switch: when `Some(true)`, the `xai.api_key` auth method is neither advertised nor accepted.
`XAI_API_KEY` and per-model credentials then can't bypass the deployment's IdP login. Env: `GROK_DISABLE_API_KEY_AUTH`.

force_login_team_uuid.description:
Restricts login to a specific team: the login token's team principal must equal this.
Also settable via `GROK_FORCE_LOGIN_TEAM_ID`; see `resolve_force_login_team` for how the tiers resolve.

oauth2.description: OAuth2 provider config. When set, it is preferred over the legacy relay flow.

oidc.description: OIDC config for customer-provided IdPs. See [`OidcAuthConfig`].

block_for_upload.description: Deprecated; a real field, not a serde alias, because an alias rejects configs setting both keys.

upload_flush_timeout_secs.description:
Budget (seconds) for the turn-end upload flush when `wait_for_uploads` is active.
Default 60.

chunk_size.description: Chunk size for the chunk scheme.

HubConfig.description:
`[hub]` section from config.toml.
Optional default Computer Hub URL for **workspace provider** exposure (`grok workspace` / leader `with_default_hub_url`).
Does **not** enable agent-side harness/client connections or alter local session behavior.

url.description:
Hub WebSocket URL (`ws://` or `wss://`) used as the leader default for
`grok workspace start` when the CLI does not pass `--hub-url`.

ManagedMcpsConfig.description:
Managed MCP connector fetching config (`[managed_mcps]` in config.toml).

See [`Self::resolve`] for full priority chain.

default_skills_installs_purged.description: Written/read out-of-band by `extensions::marketplace`, opaque so a wrong-typed value can't fail load.

official_marketplace_auto_installed.description: Written/read out-of-band by `extensions::marketplace`, opaque so a wrong-typed value can't fail load.

plugin_cta_marketplace.description: Read out-of-band by the pager (plugin-CTA marketplace override), opaque so a wrong-typed value can't fail load.

cwd.description: Standard MCP JSON supports `cwd`, but ACP stdio server config does not yet expose it.

bearer_token_env_var.description: Name of the environment variable to read and set for `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

oauth_client_id.description: OAuth client ID for providers that don't support Dynamic Client Registration.

oauth_client_secret_env_var.description: Name of the env var holding the OAuth client secret (for BYO credentials).

oauth_scopes.description: OAuth scopes to request during authorization.

expose_image_base64.description:
Also keep the raw base64 in tool-result text so agents can forward bytes via path-based tools (`base64 -d > /tmp/x.png && send_file ...`).
It roughly doubles the tokens per image. `_meta.mcpConfig.<server>.exposeImageBase64` overrides it.

tool_timeouts.description:
Per-tool timeout overrides in seconds: `{ "create_issue" = 120, "search" = 30 }`.
Tools not listed here fall back to `tool_timeout_sec`.

McpServerDecl.description:
A config-declared MCP server (pre-wire form; the producer maps it to
[`McpServerParam`] with `r#type: "url"`). `JsonSchema`: the shell row
surface (`ConfigModelOverride`, `ModelsConfig`) carries this type and
derives `JsonSchema` for the committed config schema artifact.
`PartialEq`: the shell 47b resolver replays the row value through
`debug_assert_eq!` (compile-forced, MSGW F1).

MemoryMode.description:
Persistent-memory implementation selected for a session.

The mode is resolved once with the rest of [`MemoryConfig`] and is not
changed for an already-running session.

oneOf.description: Existing summary, search, and Dream pipeline rooted at `memory/`.
Isolated topic and observation pipeline rooted at `memory-v2/`.

MemorySettings.description: Raw `[memory]` settings. Absence is preserved for per-field fallback.

agent_type.description: Fallback `agent_type` for models without a per-model override.

allowed_models.description:
Restricts which models are user-selectable for normal chat (picker, `/model`, `-m`).
Non-matching models stay in the catalog but are never shown, defaulted to, or selectable.
Special/internal models (web_search, image_description, subagents, fork secondary) are exempt. User-config globs (`*`, `?`, `[...]`) match the catalog key or model id, case-sensitive. Empty = no restriction; an excluded explicit `default`/`-m` is rejected once the model catalog is fetched. Fleet pins live on [`Requirements::allowed_models`] and replace this list.

cache_ttl.description:
Global messages-wire stable-head cache retention tier ("5m" or
"1h"); per-model `[model.<id>]` values win. `None` = unset.

default_reasoning_effort.description: Persisted effort for the default model; applied in `resolve_model_catalog`.

disable_parallel_tool_use.description:
Global disable-parallel-tool-use toggle (F5, apex-ayl.114); per-model
`[model.<id>]` values win. `None` = unset.

disabled_models.description: Remove these model IDs from the catalog entirely. Wins over `hidden_models`.

extra_headers.description:
Global default request headers applied to every model.
A per-model `[model.<id>].extra_headers` entry overrides per key (case-insensitive).

hidden_models.description: Force `hidden = true` on these model IDs (still usable via `-m`).

image_description.description: Vision model used to transcribe user-supplied images via a separate endpoint.

mcp_servers.description:
Global remote MCP server declarations (F1, apex-ayl.115, BETA
shape); per-model `[model.<id>]` values win. `None` = unset.

mcp_toolset_server.description:
Global `mcp_toolset_server` pairing key (F1, apex-ayl.115); names
an `mcp_servers` entry. Per-model `[model.<id>]` values win.
`None` = unset.

prompt_suggestion.description:
Model pin for next-prompt suggestions (tab-autocomplete ghost text).
When unset: the remote pin, then the client hint / built-in `grok-4.6` default with the catalog guard; see `ModelOverrideConfig::resolve`.

server_tools.description:
Global server-tool member selection (F1, apex-ayl.115): a
comma-separated STRING of family names or dated slugs (scalar-safe
for config_patch); resolved to canonical dated type strings at
config resolution (unknown slugs soft-refused — warn + skip).
Per-model `[model.<id>]` values win. `None` = unset (no members).

temperature.description:
Global default values applied to every model that leaves the field unset; a per-model `[model.<id>]` value always wins.
A deliberately small, allow-listed subset of the per-model fields (only `Option` ones, so "unset" is unambiguous).

thinking_replay.description:
Global older-assistant thinking replay policy
(MSGW-THINKREPLAY-1, apex-ayl.108.1); per-model `[model.<id>]`
values win. `None` = unset.

top_k.description:
Global top-k sampling (docs GA L3060); per-model `[model.<id>]`
values win. `None` = unset (absent on the wire).

OAuth2ProviderConfig.description:
OAuth2 provider configuration (`GROK_OAUTH2_ISSUER` / `GROK_OAUTH2_CLIENT_ID`).

Uses the standard OAuth 2.1 authorization code flow with PKCE via [`OidcAuthConfig`].

referrer.description: Client-supplied referrer so analytics can attribute OAuth usage.

OriginClientInfo.description:
Identity of the client that originated the request, used for User-Agent rendering.
The shell layer composes this with platform info into a final UA string.

PathsConfig.description:
`[paths]` configuration: extra directories to scan for skills, rules, etc.
These supplement the built-in scan locations (`.grok/skills/`, `.agents/skills/`, `~/.grok/skills/`). They're written by `/import-claude` to preserve previously-discovered Claude directories after the runtime `.claude/` cutoff (see `[claude_compat] imported`).

extra_rule_dirs.description: Additional directories to scan for rules (each contains `*.md`).

extra_skill_dirs.description: Additional directories to scan for skills (each contains `<skill>/SKILL.md`).

PermissionKnownKeys.description:
`[permission]` known keys, declared for the unrecognized-key scan only; consumed out-of-band.
Keys stay typed so a typo (e.g. `denny`) still warns.

PersonaIOField.description:
A declared input or output for a persona.

Enables the parent agent to discover what a persona needs (inputs) and produces (outputs) without hardcoding the persona's protocol.

description.description: Human-readable description shown in the task tool help.

PluginsConfig.description: Plugin system configuration from `[plugins]` section in config.toml.

disabled.description:
Plugin IDs or names to disable.
Disabled plugins are discovered but their components are not loaded into the session.

enabled.description:
Plugin IDs or names to explicitly enable.
Used for project-scope plugins, which are disabled by default; adding a plugin here overrides that default.

paths.description: Additional plugin directory paths to load.

PreferredAuthMethod.description:
Pins automatic auth to one method via `[auth] preferred_method`.
When the pinned method is unavailable, auth fails rather than falling back; unset keeps the multi-method fallback.
Only the config file can set this, not remote settings or env.

oneOf.description: OIDC / OAuth2 session (`cached_token`, interactive `grok.com` / `oidc`, including devbox-minted OIDC).

ReasoningEffort.description: `None`/`Minimal` are omitted on the Anthropic Messages API.

ReasoningEffortOption.description:
A single selectable reasoning-effort option for a model.
`id`/`label` are presentation and input; `value` is the canonical value sent on the wire.

RemoteAnnouncement.description: Announcement from remote settings or local override.

include_inline_fallback.description: Include inline content even when references exist.

max_inline_bytes.description: Omit inline content larger than this (0 means no limit).

untracked_max_bytes.description: Skip untracked files larger than this (0 means no limit).

SamplerConfig.description:
All knobs that control a single sampling request.
Auth is selected separately via `auth_scheme`, while `api_backend` controls only the request/response protocol shape.

compaction_at_tokens.description: Per-model config for the `x-compaction-at` header; `None` disables it.

compactions_remaining.description: Per-model config for the `x-compactions-remaining` header; `None` disables it.

context_window.description:
Total context window size in tokens.
The sampler does not enforce it; the session uses it for compaction decisions.

conversation_group_id.description: Stable root conversation identifier emitted as `x-grok-conv-group-id`.

disable_parallel_tool_use.description:
Row opt-in: disable parallel tool use (F5, apex-ayl.114); row key
`disable_parallel_tool_use` (bool). Nested into `tool_choice` on the
messages wire by the producer. `None` = toggle absent.

doom_loop_recovery.description:
Server-side doom-loop check policy; `None` disables it.
It also absorbs the reported trigger events (unlike environment headers in [`Self::extra_headers`], this gates the client's decode behavior).

env_http_headers.description: Header name to environment variable, resolved into request headers at client build and never persisted.

extra_headers.description:
Extra request headers applied verbatim. The sampler never inspects the URL to derive headers.
Callers (the session) inject proxy auth and other access headers here before constructing the config.

extra_response_includes.description: Additional Responses API `include` values not represented by the typed client.

mcp_servers.description:
Remote MCP server declarations (BETA shape, pre-wire form; the ST
`McpServerDecl` type rides the carrier — no mirror type).

mcp_toolset_server.description:
Names an `mcp_servers` entry; pairs with the "mcp_toolset" member
(the config layer hard-refuses a pairing violation).

model_family.description:
Provider family for this model (e.g. "xai", "codex"). Gates provider-specific
request patches (Codex instruction roles, max/ultra wire mapping, multi-agent v2).
`None` means xAI-default behavior.

mtls_cert_dir.description: Resolved local directory for this model's mTLS client identity.

normalize_content_types.description:
True when a family-less (or flagged) row must rewrite
`input_text`/`output_text` content parts to `"text"` for a Responses
shim that rejects the native part types (apex-ayl.77 E2 ruling R-B,
binding flag spec). The flagless path is byte-identical to the
pre-cut status quo.

query_params.description: Query parameters folded into every request URL (percent-encoded).

rate_limit_retry_threshold.description:
Total-attempt ceiling for rate-limited requests.
`None` keeps the actor's [`RetryPolicy::rate_limit_retry_threshold`].

server_tools.description:
Config-selected server-tool union members (canonical dated type
strings; the shell row key is the comma-separated STRING
`server_tools`, resolved at config resolution) (MSGW F1, apex-ayl.115).
`None` = no members (absent on the wire).

stop_sequences.description:
Custom stop strings (docs GA L1246); row key `stop_sequences` is a
comma-separated string, split + trimmed at config resolution
(empty/whitespace → `None`).

strict_responses_input.description:
True when the target backend enforces the strict OpenAI/Azure
Responses input schema: replayed `reasoning` items whose `content`
array is non-empty 400 with `array_above_max_length` (REPLAY-1).
Gates the provider-seam input projection; `false` (default) keeps the
replay byte-identical for lenient (vLLM-dialect) backends.

thinking_replay.description:
Messages-wire older-assistant thinking replay policy
(apex-ayl.108.1); `None` (default) = all-older cap-aware verbatim
replay, `"off"` = the legacy one-request strip (xli S-031 parity).
Validated at the config layer (the closed value set {None, "off"} —
unknown values are refused and mapped to None there).

tool_cache_breakpoint.description:
Row opt-in: per-tool cache breakpoint (F5, apex-ayl.114); the PLURAL
row key `tools_cache_breakpoint` (`off` | `last`) resolves to
`Option<ToolCacheBreakpoint>` at config resolution
(`off`/absent ⇒ `None`). SINGULAR field — do not unify.

top_k.description:
Top-k sampling (docs GA L3060); row key `top_k` (u32 scalar),
resolved by the shell (MGW F2, apex-ayl.113). `None` = absent on the wire.

ultra_wire_effort.description:
Menu-derived wire value for a locally-carried `ultra` (PROACTIVE-ULTRA-1 /
apex-ayl.86, ruling R-MENU-DERIVED): the highest advertised menu tier below
`ultra` (canonical effort order); `None` when the model advertises no menu
(or no non-ultra tier) — the egress then falls back to wire "max".
Resolved by the shell at the .59 seed gate; consumed by
`provider::patch_responses_request` (AXIS 1). Not a flag: it is derived
MENU DATA.

auto_allow_bash.description: Skip bash permission prompts when sandbox is active.

auto_compact_threshold_percent.description:
Context window usage percentage (0-100) at which auto-compact is triggered. `None` means the user didn't set it.
The resolver in `crate::util::config::resolve_auto_compact_threshold_percent` falls through to remote tiers and then the hardcoded default 85.
Read this field via the resolver, not directly, to honor the full precedence chain (env, per-model, remote, default).

load_envrc.description:
When enabled, the session will parse .envrc in the workspace directory and inject the environment variables into bash commands.
Defaults to `true` when unset.
`Option<bool>` so `None` round-trips as absent on disk (managed config wins over default).

ShellEnvironmentPolicyKnownKeys.description:
`[shell_environment_policy]` known keys, for the unrecognized-key scan only.
The value is parsed at spawn by [`crate::util::config::resolve_shell_env_policy`].
`Option<toml::Value>` (no `deny_unknown_fields`) keeps a typo a warning, not a load failure, like [`PermissionKnownKeys`].

ShellToolsetConfig.description:
This is the *shell-side* config that holds sampling-level settings (e.g., web search API key from the sampling client).
It is distinct from `xai_grok_tools::registry::types::ToolsetConfig` which holds tool-implementation-level config (bash limits, web search mode).

file_toolset.description: Which file-operation toolset to use: `"standard"` (default) or `"hashline"`.

bundled_skill_dirs.description: Skill dirs the launcher injects for skills bundled with the platform (tagged `Bundled` scope).

disabled.description:
Skill names that are disabled.
Disabled skills remain in the list (unlike `ignore` which hides them entirely).
They are excluded from the system prompt and skill tool invocation.

ignore.description:
Path prefixes to exclude.
Any skill whose resolved path starts with one of these entries is filtered out.
Supports `~` expansion.

paths.description:
Additional skill locations to load.
Each entry is a `SKILL.md` file or a directory walked recursively.
Supports `~` expansion.

server_skill_dirs.description: Skill dirs the launcher injects after syncing from the server (tagged `Server` scope).

StorageConfig.description:
`[storage]` section from config.toml.
Read by `resolve_cleanup_ttl_days()` in `session/persistence.rs`.

cleanup_ttl_days.description: Number of days to keep stale sessions before cleanup. Default: 30.

SubagentPersona.description:
A named persona/SOUL definition controlling tone, style, and behavior. Personas are referenced by name via the
`persona` field in the task tool. Their instructions are prepended to the child's prompt as a `<persona>` XML block.

default_isolation.description: Default isolation mode when this persona is used.

description.description:
Optional short description shown in persona summaries.
An empty or missing value falls back to the first paragraph of `instructions`.

inputs.description:
Declared inputs this persona expects.
The parent agent reads these to know what file paths or context to provide in the prompt.

instructions.description: Inline instruction text applied as a persona layer.

instructions_file.description:
Path to an instruction file (relative to workspace root).
Content is loaded at spawn time and merged with `instructions`.
If both are set, `instructions` is prepended before file content.

model.description: Model override when this persona is used.

outputs.description:
Declared outputs this persona produces.
The parent agent reads these to know what artifacts to expect and pass to the next agent.

reasoning_effort.description: Default reasoning effort for this persona (e.g. "low", "medium", "high").

SubagentRole.description:
A declarative subagent role definition from config. Roles provide named presets that callers can reference via the
`subagent_type` field in the task tool. Each role can specify a default capability mode, model override, and custom
prompt.

default_capability_mode.description:
Default capability mode for agents using this role.
One of: "read-only", "read-write", "execute", "all".
This is a config default, not an argument the model passes at spawn; `general-purpose` stays `all`.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this role does.

model.description:
Model override for this role.
If set, agents using this role default to this model unless the spawn-time `model` override is provided.

prompt_file.description:
Path to a prompt/instruction file (relative to workspace root).
Content is loaded at spawn time and prepended to the child's prompt as a `<role-instructions>` block.

reasoning_effort.description:
Default reasoning effort for this role (e.g. "low", "medium", "high").
Can be overridden per-spawn via `reasoning_effort` in the task tool.

SubagentsConfig.description:
Configuration for subagent (task tool) support.
Parsed from the `[subagents]` section of `~/.grok/config.toml` or `.grok/config.toml`.
Enabled by default; can be disabled via the `GROK_SUBAGENTS=0` env var or `[subagents] enabled = false` in config.toml.

max_depth.description: Raw `[subagents] max_depth` (i64 so out-of-range parses; clamped to at least 1 at resolve).

models.description:
Per-subagent model ID overrides.
Keys are agent names, values are model IDs that must exist in the available models registry.
Parsed from `[subagents.models]` in config.toml.

toggle.description:
Per-subagent enable/disable toggles.
Keys are agent names, values are booleans.
Omitted agents default to enabled (`true`).

enabled.description: Declared for `serde_ignored`. Actual toggle is `[features] telemetry`.

otel_endpoint.description: External OTLP base endpoint (`/v1/logs`, `/v1/metrics` appended for HTTP).

otel_log_assistant_responses.description: External OTEL content gate. Unset follows `otel_log_user_prompts`.

otel_log_tool_content.description: External OTEL content gate for full tool/MCP bodies (default off).

otel_log_tool_details.description: External OTEL content gate (admins can pin to `false` via requirements).

otel_log_user_prompts.description: External OTEL content gate (admins can pin to `false` via requirements).

otel_metric_export_interval.description: Milliseconds as a decimal string. TOML accepts integer or string.

otel_timeout.description: Milliseconds as a decimal string. TOML accepts integer or string.

trace_upload.description: `None` inherits from `[features] telemetry`; `Some(false)` disables GCS uploads only.

exclude_default.description: When true, drop remote/default tips entirely.

ToolCacheBreakpoint.description:
Per-tool cache breakpoint placement (F5, apex-ayl.114): `Last` marks the
final tool with a ttl-less ephemeral cache_control (spends the free 4th
marker slot); `Off` (and `None` on resolved configs) = no tool marker.
Row key `tools_cache_breakpoint` (plural) takes the string `off` | `last`
(case-insensitive; unknown values are soft-refused at the config layer).

ToolsConfig.description:
Tool behavior configuration (`[tools]` in config.toml).
Controls cross-cutting tool behavior such as `.gitignore` filtering.

disable_zdr_incompatible_tools.description:
Restrict tools whose xAI API requires server-side artifact storage (currently just the video tools).
Without a valid `[tools.zdr_video_output_s3]` bucket they stay advertised but return setup guidance at call time.
Intended for ZDR-bound teams via `~/.grok/managed_config.toml`. Defaults to `false`.

respect_gitignore.description:
When `true`, all tools (including `read_file`) filter gitignored files.
When `false` (default), each tool picks its own default.

zdr_video_output_s3.description:
Optional S3 bucket config for ZDR video output. When present (and valid), video tools presign an upload URL and pass it to the API.
The generated video then lands in a team-owned bucket instead of being downloaded locally. Only effective when `disable_zdr_incompatible_tools` is `true`. Populated from `[tools.zdr_video_output_s3]` in config.

auto_dark_theme.description: Theme to use when the OS is in dark mode. Written by the pager's theme persist module.

auto_light_theme.description: Theme to use when the OS is in light mode. Written by the pager's theme persist module.

cancel_subagents_on_turn_cancel.description:
When cancelling a parent turn with running subagents: `always_stop` stops them without prompting, `always_continue` leaves them running.
Unset/`ask` shows the cancel-turn picker.
Written by the pager when the user picks "Always stop" / "Always continue".

collapsed_edit_blocks.description:
Show Edit tool calls as a collapsed one-line `+N/-M` diffstat summary by default (expand for the diff).
`None` means off (client default). Written by the pager's settings modal.

combine_queued_prompts.description: Combine consecutive queued follow-ups into one turn. `None` means off.

compact_mode.description: Read by pager, declared here for `serde_ignored`.

confirm_before_rewind.description:
Ask before rewinding conversation history. `None` means on (default).
Written by the pager's settings modal / rewind "Yes, and don't ask again".

contextual_hints.description:
Per-tip contextual-hint opt-outs (`[ui.contextual_hints]`).
Each `None` inherits the remote/default (on); `Some` is a user-explicit choice that beats the remote tier.
Skipped on the wire when untouched so the section only appears once a user toggles a tip.

cursor_blink.description:
Startup cursor style: `None` (default) inherits the terminal's own style.
`Some(true)` forces the legacy blinking block, `Some(false)` a steady block.
Config-file-only knob (no /settings row).

default_selected_permission.description:
Which permission option the cursor preselects on the first permission prompt of a session. One of `allow_once`,
`allow_always`, or `reject`. After the first prompt, the cursor sticks to the user's last-used option kind. When
unset, the first prompt preselects the "Always allow on all sessions" (enable-always-approve) row.

display_refresh.description:
Display-refresh probe and auto-cadence (`[ui.display_refresh]`).
Per-field `None` inherits remote/default; skipped when untouched.

double_click_action.description:
Retired hidden opt-in for terminal-like double/triple-click word/line selection. Superseded by `keep_text_selection =
"word_select"`. Still read only when `keep_text_selection` is unset; Settings clears this on write. `"word_select"` |
unset.

follow_up_behavior.description:
Mid-turn follow-up routing: `"queue"` (default) or `"steer"`. `None` behaves as queue.
Steer promotes server-queued follow-ups as interjections at the next tool or model safe point.

fork_secondary_model.description:
Model ID to use for the secondary agent when forking.
Defaults to the main default model (from default_models.json).

group_tool_verbs.description:
Fold runs of consecutive non-destructive tool calls (reads, searches, lists) into one transcript row.
`None` means on (client default). Written by the pager's settings modal.

hunk_tracker_mode.description:
Hunk-tracker mode the pager advertises to the agent (`agent_only` | `all_dirty` | `off`).
Written by the pager's settings modal; read at connect time (CLI `--hunk-tracker-mode` / `GROK_HUNK_TRACKER` override it).
Unset defaults to `off`, which disables hunk tracking entirely.

keep_text_selection.description: In-app drag selection highlight: `flash` | `hold` (legacy bool accepted).

mouse_reporting_toggle.description:
When `true`, registers `Ctrl+R` (while scrollback is focused) to toggle terminal mouse reporting (mouse capture). That
hands selection back to the terminal for native click-drag copy/paste. Opt-in only; unset/false leaves mouse reporting
always on with no toggle shortcut. The prompt keeps `Ctrl+R` for history search; focus scrollback (Esc/Tab) first.

page_flip_on_send.description:
Snap a just-sent prompt to the viewport top. `None` means on (default).
Written by the pager's settings modal.

prompt_suggestions.description:
Next-prompt suggestions (tab autocomplete ghost text) after each turn.
`None` means on (client default).
Written by the pager's settings modal; the `GROK_PROMPT_SUGGESTIONS` env var overrides at runtime.

remember_tool_approvals.description:
User knob for the `remember_tool_approvals` gate: per-tool "Always allow …" prompt options (resolver default: on).
Written by the settings modal; requirements/env/managed/remote settings also feed the gate.

render_mermaid.description:
How ` ```mermaid ` code blocks are rendered (`auto` | `on` | `off`).
Written by the pager's settings modal.

screen_mode.description: `"fullscreen"` | `"minimal"`; unset uses the product default, fullscreen.

scroll_lines.description:
Lines per scroll tick, applied to BOTH wheel and trackpad pricing (1 to 10).
Unset keeps the per-terminal scroll profile's values.

scroll_mode.description:
Force scroll input classification (`auto` | `wheel` | `trackpad`).
Written by the pager's settings modal; unset defaults to `auto`.

scroll_speed.description: Mouse-wheel and trackpad scroll speed multiplier (1 to 100).

selection_highlight_duration_ms.description: Legacy TTL ms; only `Some(0)` counts when `keep_text_selection` is unset.

show_thinking_blocks.description:
Show agent thinking/reasoning blocks in the TUI scrollback.
`None` means on (client default). Written by the pager's settings modal.

show_timeline.description:
Timeline sidebar (per-turn tick rail in place of the scrollbar).
`None` means off (client default; opt-in). Written by the pager's settings modal.

show_timestamps.description: Written by the pager's appearance persist module.

simple_mode.description: Read by pager, declared here for `serde_ignored`.

ui_theme.description: UI theme alias. Read by `util::config`, declared here for `serde_ignored`.

voice_capture_mode.description:
Voice capture chord behavior: `toggle` or `hold` (hold-to-talk; needs a Kitty-protocol terminal, else falls back to toggle).
Written by the settings modal; unset defaults to `hold`.

voice_keybind_enabled.description:
Whether the Ctrl+Space / F8 voice-dictation shortcut is active.
Written by the settings modal; unset defaults to `true` (shortcut on).
When `false` the chord is ignored; `/voice` still starts dictation.

voice_stt_language.description:
Speech-to-text language preference for voice dictation. A Grok STT catalog code (`en`, `es`, `ja`, …; see xAI STT
supported languages) or `auto` (system locale, resolved at connect). Written by the settings modal; unset leaves
`[voice].language` / default `en`. When set, overrides `[voice].language` for the session.

VendorCompatToml.description:
Raw per-vendor compat cells parsed from `[compat.<vendor>]` TOML.

Resolution order is env override, this value, remote flag, default ON.

WebFetchToolConfig.description: User configurable settings for the web_fetch tool (`[toolset.web_fetch]`).

allow_local.description:
Allow fetches to explicit loopback hosts only (`localhost` / `127.0.0.0/8` / `::1`).
Private and metadata ranges stay blocked.
Resolution: TOML > `GROK_WEB_FETCH_ALLOW_LOCAL` env > false.

allowed_domains.description:
When set, it overrides the built-in default allowlist.
An explicit empty list blocks all fetches.
Resolution: TOML > remote settings > built-in defaults.

proxy_endpoint.description:
When set, all HTTP requests are routed through this URL.
Resolution: TOML > `GROK_WEB_FETCH_PROXY` env > remote settings > None.

WorktreeAutoGcSettings.description:
Policy from the local `[worktree.auto_gc]` table or the remote `worktree_auto_gc` object.
Each field deserializes tolerantly, so one bad key cannot drop a sibling kill-switch.

dry_run.description: When set, counts worktrees old enough to delete without deleting them.

enabled.description: `Some(false)` is a kill-switch; absent defaults to on (an env kill still applies).

include_orphan_snapshots.description: Only has an effect on Linux.

include_rebuild.description: Also rebuild discovery and scrub grok's stale `.git/worktrees/` entries (default off).

max_age_by_kind.description:
Per-kind max ages (`session`, `ab`, `pool`, `fork`, `manual`, `subagent`), each seconds or `"never"`.
Absent keys use the defaults; the client default keeps `manual` at never.
Remote may set `manual` to a finite TTL, and local TOML can restore `"never"`.
Unknown kind keys are ignored at resolve time.

max_age_secs.description: Age cutoff in seconds, on platforms where expiring by age is allowed; the resolver clamps it.

min_interval_secs.description: Minimum seconds between successful auto-GC runs; the resolver clamps it.

rebuild_min_interval_secs.description: Seconds between rebuilds, throttled independently of GC; absent means 24h. It is clamped like `min_interval_secs`.

WorktreeConfigSection.description: `[worktree]` section from config.toml (auto-GC policy lives under `auto_gc`).

WorktreeKindMaxAge.description: Per-kind age policy for auto-GC: seconds or never.

WorktreePoolConfig.description:
Deprecated `[worktree_pool]` section. The pre-warmed worktree pool was deleted (never wired into production).
The section is still parsed so existing user configs don't trip unknown-key warnings.

agent.description: Set in `config.toml` under `[agent]` to choose which agent definition is used for all sessions (unless overridden by CLI flag or ACP meta).

auth.description:
`[auth]` alias: consumed by `expand_auth_alias` before serde.
Typed as `GrokComConfig` (same schema) so sub-field typos are caught.

compat.description:
Raw `[compat]` vendor-compatibility config (per-vendor, per-surface toggles).
Resolved into [`Config::compat_resolved`] by `resolve_runtime_fields`.

default_auto_mode.description: Start sessions in auto permission mode (classifier) when no per-session override.

desktop.description: `[desktop]` section: owned by grok-desktop (Electron app), opaque to the CLI agent.

disable_web_search.description:
Whether web search is force-disabled via `--disable-web-search` CLI flag.
When true, the web search tool is never added to the agent toolset regardless of available credentials.

doom_loop_recovery.description:
`[doom_loop_recovery]` section: the shared settings struct.
ONE type serves this TOML table and the remote settings `doom_loop_recovery` object.
See [`crate::util::config::DoomLoopRecoverySettings`].

hints.description: Written by the client via `config_toml_edit`; absorbed so it isn't flagged as an unrecognized key.

path_not_found_hints.description:
Whether to enrich path-not-found errors with CWD reminders, "dropped repo folder" correction, and similar-name suggestions. Default `false`. Enabled via remote settings.
Serialized to `config.json` on GCS so traces can distinguish which sessions had path-not-found hints active.

prompt_suggestions.description: Declared so documented sampling keys are not reported as unrecognized.

shell_environment_policy.description: Validation only; the value is parsed at spawn by `resolve_shell_env_policy`.
